# stuff

> A private, Google Sheets- and Drive-backed home inventory. The Sheet is the source of truth and can be operated directly by authorized agents.

Production: https://stuff.piszek.com/
Privacy: https://stuff.piszek.com/privacy.html

## Agent instructions

- Full skill and schema: https://stuff.piszek.com/SKILL.md
- Use the skill only with a Google Sheet or Drive resource the user is authorized to access.
- Verify `Settings` contains `database_type=stuff`, `schema_version=1`, and `migration_state=idle` before writing.
- Identify columns by header name, preserve unknown columns, and use stable IDs rather than row numbers.
- Use the website for migrations, schema repair, and ambiguous or unsafe structural changes.

## Project

- Source: https://github.com/artpi/stuff
